heading: No J_max deployment parameter
text:
### No J_max deployment parameter [LNLS.7.3]

Unlike the general case where J_max must be declared or measured,
`linear_scan: false` programs have **no J_max parameter** — the compiler
proves J_max = 1 structurally from the schema lifecycle declarations.
There is nothing to declare, measure, or tune.  The beta cost is O(1)
by construction for all deployments.
